hooks.name: Component Scaffold
hooks.description: When a new component is created, scaffold a matching test and Storybook story.

action.prompt: A new React component was created. Scaffold a co-located test file (React Testing Library) covering render + key interactions, and a Storybook story with default and edge-case args. Infer props from the component. Do not modify the component itself unless it is missing an explicit export.
